title: Stable Language Guidance for Vision–Language–Action Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models on the LIBERO robotic manipulation benchmark under controlled linguistic perturbations (e.g., destructive instruction overwriting, obfuscated reinterpretation, and out-of-distribution semantic transfer) to measure the models' overreliance on visual scene priors and physical affordances over actual linguistic instructions.
